text:
anya: quick sweep of the catalog intake turned up 3 small snags for incoming open models — bramble-7b (license clarity), tide-3b (tokenizer/metadata), feldspar-small (perf regression after quant). tagging owners: @jamal @suhas @curation @lina-legal — please ack and short plan

jamal: ack — I own bramble-7b. Legal shows 'non-commercial' language that might be blocking hosted usage. @lina-legal can you confirm whether we can serve via hosted API or only enterprise/dedicated?

lina-legal: looking now. need the exact license file & provenance. if it is plain NC we likely need enterprise-only routing. can you drop the model URL + license snippet?

jamal: link: https://huggingface.co/bramble-7b and license snippet pasted in PR comment. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4823 (labelled needs-legal).

devex-bot: PR created: https://git.company/repo/pull/4823 — please add `legal-review` label if you want expedited review.

suhas: tide-3b tokenizer mismatch — model uses sentencepiece but our ingestion expects byte-level BPE. short plan: implement a lightweight tokenizer shim during loading, measure added latency. cc @olivia for canary window.

olivia: staging is already booked mid-week but we have a Thu 00:00-06:00 PST canary window. shim adding ~30-60ms is probably fine but need bench numbers.

suhas: will run microbench and post numbers before EOD.

ingest: tide-3b manifest missing `embedding_shape` — ingestion fails on embed tests. @curation please backfill or ingestion will reject.

curation: noted, will backfill. looks like embedding dim should be 384 per vendor tags, will add to manifest and re-ingest.

jamal: feldspar-small perf — after applied quant profile token throughput dropped ~18% locally. might be KV cache misalignment in our runtime. @suhas can you pair?

suhas: yep, can pair. jamal — paste the `./bench` output or logs and I'll take a look.

jamal: pasted bench output to PR comment (see PR #4823) and included minimal repro command.

legal-bot: license-checker: bramble-7b flagged "NonCommercial" clause — severity MED — action: request provenance & permissions. Ticket LEG-212 created.

lina-legal: opened LEG-212 and assigned to me. aim to update EOD tomorrow. if confirmed NC-only, plan is to gate by routing to dedicated/private until legal clears.

matt: quick ping — manifest + ingestion PR needs a reviewer for schema change (PR #4825). @jamal can you add reviewers?

jamal: added @matt and @suhas as reviewers. will split large changes into two PRs if it helps review throughput.

olivia: suggestion — temporary routing rule: if license unresolved, route traffic to `dedicated` by default. ops needs a flag. @ingest @devex-bot can you create the infra ticket?

devex-bot: feature-flag available: `route:dedicated-on-unknown-license`. Toggle via Console -> Feature Flags. Create INF ticket to request rollout.

ingest: INF-998 created to wire the flag into ingestion routing, assigned to infra-squad.

anya: summary / next steps — jamal: gather license docs + update PR; suhas: tokenization shim & perf numbers; curation: manifest embedding backfill; olivia: confirm canary slot + any perf concerns; matt: review manifest PR. Please reply with a single-line "ack" when your item is done so I can close the sweep by EOD Fri.

matt: ack — will review PRs today.

suhas: ack pending bench results (will post numbers in this thread when done).

curation: ack — embedding shape backfilled, pushed manifest change.

jamal: ack — added license snippet and provenance link to PR, awaiting legal update.

lina-legal: ack — opened LEG-212, will update outcome tomorrow EOD.

anya: thanks all. if anything becomes blocking sooner than expected, ping me directly. otherwise I'll mark this sweep as active and close when all acks are in. :thumbsup:
